# EVISU

> > EVISU is a premium Japanese denim and streetwear brand featuring signature Seagull embroidery, Kamon prints, and Godhead motifs across their collections.

EVISU offers a range of contemporary streetwear including denim, graphic tees, hoodies, and accessories for men, women, and kids (EVISU KIZZU). The brand blends traditional Japanese design elements like Daruma, Fortune Cat, and Kamon patterns with modern silhouettes and premium denim craftsmanship.

## Key Topics

- Seagull embroidery and prints
- Kamon traditional Japanese patterns
- EVISUKURO collection
- Godhead motifs
- Daruma prints
- Fortune Cat graphics
- Premium denim construction
- Japanese streetwear aesthetics
- Oversized and relaxed fits
- 3D cut jeans
- Logo intarsia detailing
- EVISU KIZZU kids line
- Vintage Japanese prints
- Fashion fit silhouettes
